############################################################################
# CMakeLists.txt file for building the tests of the differentiation of the
# code generated by ONNXToCpp with Clad. They run in ROOT's interpreter and use
# ROOT's testing infrastructure, so they are separate from the other tests.
# @author Federico Sossai, Sanjiban Sengupta
############################################################################

# The generated models use BLAS for Gemm (the interpreter finds the symbols in the executable)
find_package(BLAS)

if(BLAS_FOUND)
  # Differentiation of the emitted Gemm_Call helper and its custom derivative
  ROOT_ADD_GTEST(TestONNXToCppGemmDerivative TestONNXToCppGemmDerivative.cxx
    LIBRARIES Core BLAS::BLAS ROOTInternalONNXToCpp)

  # Differentiation of generated models. The models are generated with Python and
  # onnx, and the code for them is generated before running the test.
  ROOT_FIND_PYTHON_MODULE(onnx)
  if(ROOT_ONNX_FOUND)
    set(CLAD_MODELS_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/input_models)
    configure_file(EmitCladModels.cxx.in EmitCladModels.cxx @ONLY)
    ROOT_EXECUTABLE(ONNXToCppEmitCladModels ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/EmitCladModels.cxx
      LIBRARIES Core ROOTInternalONNXToCpp)

    ROOT_ADD_TEST(roofit-roofit-onnx_to_cpp-test_clad-ONNXToCppCladGenerateModels
                  COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generate_clad_models.py --outdir ${CLAD_MODELS_DIR}
                  FIXTURES_SETUP onnxtocpp-clad-generate-models)

    ROOT_ADD_TEST(roofit-roofit-onnx_to_cpp-test_clad-ONNXToCppCladCompileModels
                  COMMAND ONNXToCppEmitCladModels
                  FIXTURES_REQUIRED onnxtocpp-clad-generate-models
                  FIXTURES_SETUP onnxtocpp-clad-compile-models)

    ROOT_EXECUTABLE(TestONNXToCppCladAutodiff TestONNXToCppCladAutodiff.cxx
      LIBRARIES Core BLAS::BLAS ROOTInternalONNXToCpp GTest::gtest GTest::gtest_main)
    ROOT_ADD_TEST(roofit-roofit-onnx_to_cpp-test_clad-TestONNXToCppCladAutodiff
                  COMMAND TestONNXToCppCladAutodiff
                  WORKING_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
                  FIXTURES_REQUIRED onnxtocpp-clad-compile-models)
  endif()
endif()
